Pump hips up and down with rhythm for high reps (20-50+)

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
description: Unilateral hip thrust variation challenging glutes and hip stability on single leg.
key_principles: One leg elevated, drive through working heel, maintain level hips, squeeze glute, balance.
key_technical_checkpoints: One foot down, other leg extended, hips level, full extension, working glute contracts.
instructions: Lie on back, one foot flat on floor, extend other leg straight up
Keep extended leg straight and elevated throughout movement
Drive through heel of planted foot, lift hips up
Squeeze working glute, maintain level hips, no tilting
Lower with control, tap ground lightly
Complete all reps on one side before switching legs

name: Clamshell
description: Targeted hip abduction exercise for glute medius and hip external rotators, excellent for hip health.
key_principles: Side-lying position, feet together, open top knee, squeeze glute, controlled tempo.
key_technical_checkpoints: Lie on side, knees bent, feet together, top knee opens like clamshell, no hip rolling back.
instructions: Lie on side with knees bent 90 degrees, feet together
Rest head on bottom arm, keep hips stacked vertically
Keeping feet together, lift top knee up as high as possible
Focus on glute medius contraction, don't let hips roll back
Hold briefly at top position, squeeze glute
Lower knee with control, repeat all reps, then switch sides

name: Fire Hydrant
description: Quadruped hip abduction exercise targeting glutes and hip stabilizers.
key_principles: Table-top position, lift leg to side, knee stays bent, squeeze glute, no torso rotation.
key_technical_checkpoints: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, lift leg out to side, knee bent 90 degrees.
instructions: Start on hands and knees in table-top position
Keep core engaged, spine neutral throughout movement
Lift one leg out to side maintaining 90-degree knee bend
Raise knee to hip height or slightly above, like fire hydrant
Squeeze glute at top, avoid rotating torso or tilting pelvis
Lower with control, repeat all reps, then switch legs

name: Hip Airplane
description: Advanced single-leg hip mobility drill improving internal and external rotation while balancing.
key_principles: Single leg balance, rotate at hip, control throughout, maintain balance, both directions.
key_technical_checkpoints: Standing leg stable, hinge at hip, rotate leg internally and externally, smooth motion.
instructions: Stand on one leg, hinge forward at hip to about 45 degrees
Extend free leg behind you parallel to ground
Keeping hips hinged, rotate free leg like airplane propeller
Rotate from hip joint through full internal and external rotation
Maintain balance on standing leg throughout motion
Complete desired reps/rotations, then switch to other leg

name: 90-90 Hip Stretch
description: Seated hip mobility stretch working both internal and external rotation simultaneously.
key_principles: Both legs at 90 degrees, sit tall, lean forward gently, breathe, hold stretch, switch sides.
key_technical_checkpoints: Both knees 90 degrees, shins parallel, upright posture, gentle forward lean if able.
instructions: Sit on floor with both legs bent at 90-degree angles
Position front leg with knee pointing forward, back leg with knee to side
Sit as upright as possible with tall spine
Lean forward gently over front leg if seeking deeper stretch
Hold position breathing deeply for 30-60 seconds
Switch leg positions and repeat on opposite side

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Seated calf exercise targeting soleus muscle with knees bent position.
key_principles: Full range of motion, stretch at bottom, squeeze at top, controlled tempo, progressive load.
key_technical_checkpoints: Knees bent 90 degrees, balls of feet on platform, full stretch and contraction, no bouncing.
instructions: Sit on calf raise machine with balls of feet on platform
Position knees under pads, adjust weight appropriately
Lower heels as far below platform as possible for full stretch
Press up onto toes raising heels as high as possible
Squeeze calves hard at peak contraction, hold briefly
Lower with control to full stretch, repeat without bouncing

name: Donkey Calf Raise
description: Bent-over calf raise allowing extreme stretch and range of motion for calf development.
key_principles: Bent at hips, full stretch, drive through balls of feet, maximum height, controlled descent.
key_technical_checkpoints: Hips hinged, back flat, full ankle dorsiflexion at bottom, maximum plantarflexion at top.
instructions: Position on donkey calf raise machine or lean over platform
Hinge at hips to 90 degrees, back flat, weight on hips/back
Stand on balls of feet on elevated platform
Lower heels below platform level as far as possible
Drive up onto toes raising heels as high as possible
Squeeze calves at top, lower slowly to deep stretch, repeat

name: Single Leg Calf Raise
description: Single leg calf raise improving balance and addressing strength imbalances.
key_principles: One leg at a time, full range, balance throughout, hold support lightly, equal reps both sides.
key_technical_checkpoints: Stand on one foot, free leg relaxed, full stretch to full contraction, stable throughout.
instructions: Stand on one leg on edge of step or platform
Hold wall or support lightly for balance only
Lower heel below step level for maximum calf stretch
Press up onto toes raising heel as high as possible
Squeeze calf hard at top, maintain balance
Lower slowly to full stretch, complete all reps, switch legs

name: Jump Rope (Calf Focus)
description: Jump rope exercise with emphasis on calf conditioning and endurance.
key_principles: Stay on balls of feet, quick ground contact, calves absorb and push, rhythmic breathing, build duration.
key_technical_checkpoints: Minimal knee bend, ankles do the work, light bounces, stay on toes, consistent rhythm.
instructions: Hold jump rope handles, position rope behind feet
Stay on balls of feet throughout, minimal knee involvement
Jump just high enough to clear rope, quick ground contact
Let calves do the work absorbing landing and propelling next jump
Maintain steady rhythm and pace for desired time interval
Start with 30-60 seconds, build to several minutes for calf endurance

name: Wrist Curl
description: Forearm flexor exercise building wrist curl strength and forearm mass.
key_principles: Forearms supported, wrist only moves, full range, controlled tempo, light weight high reps.
key_technical_checkpoints: Forearms on bench, palms up, wrists curl weight up, full extension and flexion.
instructions: Sit on bench, rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms facing up
Hold dumbbells or barbell with wrists extended over edge
Let weight pull wrists down into full extension stretch
Curl wrists up by contracting forearm flexors
Squeeze at top of curl, then lower with control to stretch
Keep forearms stationary, only wrists move throughout

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Forearm extensor exercise for balanced forearm development and wrist health.
key_principles: Forearms supported, palms down, wrists extend up, controlled movement, lighter weight than flexors.
key_technical_checkpoints: Forearms stable, palms down, wrists extend upward, full range, slow and controlled.
instructions: Sit on bench, rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms facing down
Hold dumbbells or barbell with wrists extended over edge
Let weight pull wrists down toward floor
Extend wrists upward by contracting forearm extensors
Squeeze briefly at top, lower with control to starting position
Use lighter weight than wrist curls, forearms stay on support

name: Farmer's Walk
description: Loaded carry exercise building grip strength, forearm endurance, and total body stability.
key_principles: Heavy weight, walk distance, maintain grip, upright posture, core tight, breathing steady.
key_technical_checkpoints: Heavy dumbbells or implements, tall posture, shoulders down, strong grip, steady pace.
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, or farmer's walk handles
Stand tall with shoulders down and back, core engaged
Grip weights firmly, maintain upright posture throughout
Walk forward at steady pace for desired distance or time
Keep grip tight entire time, don't let shoulders shrug up
Set weights down safely when grip begins to fail

name: Dead Hang
description: Simple but effective hanging exercise building grip endurance and shoulder health.
key_principles: Full body weight, relaxed hang, active shoulders, hold as long as possible, build time.
key_technical_checkpoints: Full dead hang, arms straight, shoulders engaged slightly, breathe steadily.
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip shoulder-width apart
Let body hang with arms fully extended
Engage shoulders slightly to protect joint, don't be completely passive
Hold this position as long as possible maintaining grip
Breathe steadily throughout, don't hold breath
When grip fails, drop safely and rest, build up hold time over weeks

name: Plate Pinch
description: Pinch grip exercise using weight plates to develop thumb and finger pinch strength.
key_principles: Pinch with fingers and thumb, hold smooth side, static hold, progressive weight, both hands.
key_technical_checkpoints: Smooth side out, fingers on one side thumb on other, vertical hold, no resting on body.
instructions: Take one or two weight plates, smooth sides facing out
Pinch plates between fingers and thumb of one hand
Lift plates off ground holding vertically at your side
Hold this position as long as possible squeezing to maintain grip
When grip fails, set down safely and shake out hand
Complete hold on other hand, aim for equal time both sides

name: Towel Pull-Up
description: Pull-up variation using towel for extreme grip challenge and forearm development.
key_principles: Grip towel firmly, pull-up as normal, crushing grip required, forearms burn, scale as needed.
key_technical_checkpoints: Towel draped over bar, grip towel tight, pull up, full range, controlled descent.
instructions: Drape towel or two towels over pull-up bar
Grip each side of towel firmly with each hand
Hang with arms extended, gripping towel tightly
Pull yourself up just like regular pull-up while maintaining grip
Squeeze towel continuously, forearms will fatigue quickly
Lower with control, complete as many reps as grip allows

name: Spider Curl
description: Strict bicep curl over incline bench eliminating momentum and maximizing bicep isolation.
key_principles: Arms vertical, no swing, strict form, full contraction, squeeze at top, slow eccentric.
key_technical_checkpoints: Chest against bench, arms hang vertical, curl straight up, full range, elbows stationary.
instructions: Set incline bench to 45 degrees, lie face down with chest against bench
Let arms hang straight down holding dumbbells, perpendicular to floor
Keep upper arms stationary, curl weights up toward shoulders
Squeeze biceps hard at top of curl with full contraction
Lower with control to full arm extension maintaining tension
No momentum possible in this position, very strict bicep isolation

name: JM Press
description: Tricep-focused press combining elements of close-grip bench and skull crusher for maximum tricep overload.
key_principles: Hybrid movement, lower to lower chest/upper abs, press straight up, heavy loading possible, strict form.
key_technical_checkpoints: Bar lowers to chest/abs area, elbows stay in, press straight up, feel in triceps not chest.
instructions: Lie on bench, grip barbell with close grip (6-8 inches apart)
Start with bar over chest, arms extended
Lower bar under control toward lower chest/upper abdomen
Keep elbows tucked, feel stretch in triceps throughout descent
Press bar straight back up by extending elbows and contracting triceps
Use spotter for safety, this allows heavy weight for triceps

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Bicep curl on incline bench providing maximum stretch and emphasizing long head of biceps.
key_principles: Arms hang back, full stretch, curl up, maintain arm angle, squeeze biceps, slow eccentric.
key_technical_checkpoints: Bench inclined 45-60 degrees, arms hang back, curl without moving upper arms forward.
instructions: Set bench to 45-60 degree incline, sit with back against pad
Let arms hang straight down and slightly back holding dumbbells
Without moving upper arms forward, curl weights up toward shoulders
Keep upper arms stationary in same position throughout movement
Squeeze biceps at top, feel peak contraction
Lower slowly to full stretch position, repeat maintaining arm angle

name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension (Rope)
description: High cable rope extension with overhead position for maximum tricep long head activation.
key_principles: Elbows high and forward, only forearms move, full extension, squeeze triceps, slow return.
key_technical_checkpoints: Face away from cable, rope behind head, elbows stationary, full extension forward.
instructions: Set cable at high position with rope attachment, face away from machine
Grip rope with both hands, step forward creating tension
Position rope behind head, elbows bent and pointing forward
Extend arms forward and up by contracting triceps
Squeeze triceps hard at full extension, hold briefly
Lower with control feeling stretch in triceps, repeat

name: 21s (Bicep Curl)
description: Intense bicep training method doing 21 total reps across three ranges of motion without rest.
key_principles: Three ranges: bottom half (7), top half (7), full range (7), no rest between, lighter weight, pump.
key_technical_checkpoints: 7 bottom-to-middle, 7 middle-to-top, 7 full range, continuous tension, controlled throughout.
instructions: Hold barbell or dumbbells, start with arms fully extended
Perform 7 reps from bottom to halfway point (90 degrees)
Immediately do 7 reps from halfway point to full contraction
Without rest, perform 7 full range reps from bottom to top
Total of 21 reps without stopping, intense bicep pump
Use lighter weight than normal curls, focus on mind-muscle connection
